headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin launched new Fenix 9 smartwatches. Features include brighter OLED displays up to 3,000 nits. The base model starts at $999.99 with more RAM.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: DHS implemented a new $103,000 fee for H-1B visas. State Department plans to revoke up to 200,000 asylum seeker visas. This policy change impacts Big Tech's preferred visa program.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: Daniel Mullins' acclaimed deckbuilder Inscryption is on sale for $8. It's a secret-packed game from the creator of Pony Island. This is a fantastic discount on a unique title.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. The updated game launches September 29th with visual and combat improvements. It includes a reimagined skill tree and initial expansions.

headline: For Today Only, Best Buy Has a 5TB Seagate Portable Hard Drive for $169.99
summary: Best Buy offers a 5TB Seagate Portable Hard Drive. It's currently available for $169.99. This is a great price for high-capacity portable storage.

headline: This LEGO Gift Card Deal Can Save You $65 on the Massive Minas Tirith Set
summary: A LEGO gift card deal offers $65 off the Minas Tirith set. This massive Lord of the Rings build is now more affordable. A perfect opportunity for collectors.

headline: Apple's 2nd Generation AirTags Drop to a New Price Low
summary: Apple's 2nd Generation AirTags have reached a new low price. They are practical for tracking wallets, keys, and remotes. Ideal for iPhone owners prone to losing items.

headline: Save Over 50% Off the Ultra Premium LG G5 Gallery Series 4K TV With Tandem OLED Technology
summary: Get over 50% off the LG G5 Gallery Series 4K TV. This premium 2025 OLED model originally retailed for $2,400. An exceptional deal on a high-end television.

headline: Dolly Parton: The life of an iconic country singer
summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has passed away at 80. Her team announced the news on social media. The world mourns the loss of a beloved legend.

headline: Father's house rammed before son died in A66 crash
summary: A house was rammed before a fatal crash on the A66. Cole Worthy's son tragically died in the incident. The father's home sustained significant damage.

headline: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
summary: US media reports indicate the CIA chief traveled to Moscow. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft's journey. The purpose of these unannounced talks remains unclear.

headline: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
summary: Canada announced retaliatory tariffs against the US. New levies on goods from steel to tuna could reach 50%. This marks an escalation in the ongoing trade dispute.
